subject: general
question: Which one of the following is NOT an element?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silica**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Silicon dioxide, also known as silica, is an oxide of silicon **with the chemical formula **SiO₂**, most commonly found in nature as quartz and in various living organisms. In many parts of the world, silica is the major constituent of sand.
 
• It appears naturally in several **crystalline forms,** one of which is quartz. Silicon dioxide, commonly known as **silica (and/or quartz)**, is a prevalent element in the Earth's crust.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Silicon** is one of the most useful elements to mankind. Most is used **to make alloys including aluminium-silicon and ferro-silicon (iron-silicon)**. These are used to make dynamo and transformer plates, engine blocks, cylinder heads and machine tools and to deoxidise steel. Silicon is also used to make silicones.

 
• Graphite is **a crystalline form of the element carbon**. It consists of stacked layers of graphene. Graphite occurs naturally and is the most stable form of carbon under standard conditions.
 
• Germanium is **a chemical element with the symbol Ge and atomic number 32**. It is a lustrous, hard-brittle, grayish-white metalloid in the carbon group.
